fact: Decree-Law 27/2023 of 20 October 2023 sets the trust services regime (qualified e-signatures, remote signature, recognition of electronic ID) and its preamble states the Chave Móvel Digital already works as an authentication mechanism for public administration portals and as qualified electronic signature.
title: Decreto-lei n.º 27/2023 (serviços de confiança)
publisher: Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde, I Série n.º 109
